# Firela

> Open-source (AGPL-3.0) beancount ecosystem for privacy-first personal finance.
> A beancount lifetime ledger — plain text, zero tracking. Your financial data never leaves your hand.

Firela's statement parsers span CN/HK/EU via a community contribution pipeline,
executed on-device as WebAssembly. The on-device PII sanitizer detects 11 types
of sensitive data and validates IBAN across 62 country formats. billclaw, the
collection module, is self-hostable today on Cloudflare's free tier.

## Products

- [billclaw](https://github.com/fire-la/firela-bot): self-hostable collection module + pa advisor shell. Deploys to Cloudflare Workers free tier. Exports Beancount, Ledger, CSV.
- [firela-app](https://github.com/fire-la/firela-app): Flutter mobile client for a beancount lifetime ledger. In active development.
